snippet.title: Calm Bricks - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5348660/Calm_Bricks/

Calm Bricks is a cozy brick-building game about the whole ritual: tear open the bags and dig through the pile for that one tiny piece. Follow 3D instructions or free-build in creative mode. No timers, no scores. Just a warm lamp and the click of bricks
